research_question: How can Lee's Market, a regional Asian supermarket chain, use tailored AI tools, including chatbots and conversational AI, to personalize their shoppers' experiences in ordering groceries, finding recipes, accessing product information, and enhancing self-service through 2030 and beyond?
public_evidence_instruction: Use all of the supplied public-source findings as supporting evidence in your answer.
recipient: an external party with no access to internal company documents

public_industry_facts: Instacart says Ask Instacart combines large-language-model technology with its own AI models and product-catalog data to answer grocery-shopping questions.
Instacart describes Ask Instacart as helping shoppers with meal and food-preparation questions alongside product recommendations.
Instacart describes Ask Instacart as providing information on product attributes and dietary considerations to inform shopping choices.
internal_company_metrics: Data from Lee’s Market shows that in the first quarter of 2025, 5% of clients requested a human agent due to low digital literacy.
According to internal analytics, in the second quarter of 2025, 48% of Lee's Market's online shoppers checked for grocery expiration dates using the online expiration checker.

Customer logs reveal that 40% of inquiries in that period related to product availability or ingredient details, and most of these were addressed by an AI chatbot with real-time inventory and product data access.
